paper_title: Excess Electronic Recoil Events in XENON1T
notes: Paper presents multiple searches: solar axion 3D confidence surface (gae<3.8e-12, gae*gan_eff<4.8e-18, gae*gagamma<7.7e-22 GeV^-1), neutrino magnetic moment, and bosonic dark matter. The most clean exclusion curves (Fig 10/11) are for ALP dark matter (g_ae vs mass, 1-210 keV, mapping to AxionElectron) and vector/dark photon kinetic mixing kappa vs mass. An excess at 2-3 keV is observed. No explicit numerical data table is available in the provided text for the exclusion curves; limit values must be read from plots which are not numerically accessible here. The illustrative ALP example used gae=2e-13 at 20 keV (not a limit). DM density 0.3 GeV/cm^3 assumed for bosonic DM. Multiple coupling types present, reducing confidence.
